origin.mms_origins.floran.name: Floran
origin.mms_origins.floran.description: Children of the green, the Florans drink the sun and wear the forest as armor. They bloom under open sky and slip through soil and leaf unseen, yet fire, frost and the taste of flesh are the price of their growth.
origin.mms_origins.fairy.name: Fairy
origin.mms_origins.fairy.description: Tiny winged folk of the glades, light enough to ride the wind and sharp-eyed enough to find what others miss. Villagers adore them and monsters covet them, and their delicate bodies fear every blow.
layer.mms_origins.fairy_wings.name: Wings
mms_origins.gui.choose_wings.title: Choose your Wings
mms_origins.gui.view_wings.title: Your Wings
origin.mms_origins.monarch_butterfly.des: Broad, pointed wings in fiery orange and black.
origin.mms_origins.blue_butterfly.name: Azure Wings
origin.mms_origins.blue_butterfly.descri: Soft, rounded wings in shimmering blue.
origin.mms_origins.cirno_wings.name: Cirno's Wings
origin.mms_origins.cirno_wings.descripti: Crystalline ice-fairy wings of frozen shards.
origin.mms_origins.pixie_wings.name: Fairy Wings
origin.mms_origins.pixie_wings.descripti: Iridescent gossamer wings that catch the light.
origin.mms_origins.slime_wings.name: Slime Wings
origin.mms_origins.slime_wings.descripti: Squishy translucent wings of jellied ooze.
origin.mms_origins.truffle.name: Truffle
origin.mms_origins.truffle.description: Fungal folk who fruit in the dark where things have died. Poison and hunger pass them by, but their bodies are frail and their appetite is for rot. They loose spores to run light-footed, to sicken what they strike, or to cloud a field in a haze that turns beasts to their side.
origin.mms_origins.piglin.name: Piglin
origin.mms_origins.piglin.description: Born of the bastion and the crimson waste, piglins carry gold as a birthright and barter among their own kind. The Nether's heat cannot trouble them, but the overworld sky slowly turns their minds, and villagers want nothing to do with them.
power.mms_origins.bark_skin.name: Bark Skin
power.mms_origins.bark_skin.description: Your hide has hardened into living bark.
badge.mms_origins.bark_skin.0: Armor grows with the sun, from 1 at night to 5 at noon. Without at least a quarter of your Sun Power, you have no armor at night.
power.mms_origins.photosynthesis.name: Photosynthesis
power.mms_origins.photosynthesis.descrip: Sunlight feeds you as surely as bread.
badge.mms_origins.photosynthesis.0: Hunger drains 50% slower while exposed to the sun.
power.mms_origins.heat_adaptation.name: Sun-Basked
power.mms_origins.heat_adaptation.descri: Warmth is the weather you were grown for.
badge.mms_origins.heat_adaptation.0: Take 70% less heat damage and resist heat buildup. You never overheat past half the scale.
power.mms_origins.cold_sensitivity.name: Cold-Blighted
badge.mms_origins.cold_sensitivity.0: Take double damage from freezing, and chill much faster.
power.mms_origins.quick_metabolism.name: Quick Metabolism
power.mms_origins.quick_metabolism.descr: Fast-growing things are quick to hunger.
power.mms_origins.verdant_diet.name: Verdant Diet
power.mms_origins.verdant_diet.descripti: Flesh sits wrong in a mouth made for leaves.
badge.mms_origins.verdant_diet.1: Fruit, vegetables and berries restore 50% more hunger and 100% more saturation.
power.mms_origins.diminutive.name: Diminutive
power.mms_origins.diminutive.description: You are small enough to rest in a hand, and the world lies a little farther away.
badge.mms_origins.diminutive.0: You stand a block shorter than a human, under half their height.
badge.mms_origins.diminutive.2: Hostile monsters spot you from half again as far.
power.mms_origins.light_step.name: Light Step
power.mms_origins.light_step.description: You weigh so little that the world never hears you coming.
power.mms_origins.primal_magma_feast.des: The molten heart of the primordial caves is a meal fit for a creature of fire.
badge.mms_origins.primal_magma_feast.0: You can eat primal magma. It keeps your fire power full for 30 seconds and grants Regeneration II and Absorption for 15 seconds.
badge.mms_origins.light_step.0: Your steps make no vibrations, so sculk sensors and wardens cannot hear them.
power.mms_origins.fragile_frame.name: Fragile Frame
power.mms_origins.fragile_frame.descript: A delicate frame, built for flight and not for fighting.
badge.mms_origins.fragile_frame.0: Take double damage from every source, and deal 50% less.
power.mms_origins.wall_scramble.name: Wall Scramble
power.mms_origins.wall_scramble.descript: Tiny claws find purchase on any wall.
badge.mms_origins.wall_scramble.0: [Primary] toggles wall climbing. While it is on, press against a wall to climb it.
power.mms_origins.keen_forager.name: Keen Forager
power.mms_origins.keen_forager.descripti: Small eyes miss nothing underfoot, and fortune seems to follow you through every field, foe and chest.
badge.mms_origins.keen_forager.1: +18 Luck for chest loot, and fishing draws from a richer loot table.
power.mms_origins.anxious_heart.name: Anxious Heart
power.mms_origins.anxious_heart.descript: A heavy blow sends your heart racing, dropping you from the air until you calm.
badge.mms_origins.anxious_heart.0: A single hit that costs you 4 hearts or more cancels flight for 10 s.
power.mms_origins.fairy_charm.name: Fairy Charm
power.mms_origins.fairy_charm.descriptio: Villagers are enamored by your mystique and beauty, and lower their prices for you.
badge.mms_origins.fairy_charm.0: Villager trades cost 25% less of their base price, at least 1 item off each.
power.mms_origins.fairy_blessing.name: Fairy's Blessing
power.mms_origins.fairy_blessing.descrip: Life quickens in a fairy's company, and those who tend growing things are glad of you.
badge.mms_origins.fairy_blessing.0: Other players within 12 blocks of you are blessed: Floran plants grow faster, Avian hoe harvests yield more crops and gold, and Truffles grazing shroomlight gain extra saturation. Blessings from several fairies stack, reaching full strength with 3.
power.mms_origins.wayfarer_forager.name: Wayfarer's Eye
power.mms_origins.wayfarer_forager.descr: Long roads teach you where the good things hide.
badge.mms_origins.wayfarer_forager.0: While you also hold the Explorer job: Fortune +1, Looting +1 and +8 Luck for chest loot.
power.mms_origins.wayfarer_charm.name: Worldly Charm
power.mms_origins.wayfarer_charm.descrip: Villagers warm to a traveller with stories to tell, and lower their prices for you.
badge.mms_origins.wayfarer_charm.0: While you also hold the Explorer job: villager trades cost 10% less of their base price, at least 1 item off each.
power.mms_origins.fairy_allure.name: Fairy Allure
power.mms_origins.fairy_allure.descripti: The same mystique that charms villagers draws monsters to you.
badge.mms_origins.fairy_allure.0: Idle hostile mobs that can see you sometimes single you out over other prey.
power.mms_origins.fairy_flight.name: Fairy Flight
power.mms_origins.fairy_flight.descripti: While your belly is full, take wing and fly freely. Hunger drags you back to the earth.
badge.mms_origins.fairy_flight.0: Double-tap jump to fly. Needs at least 3 drumsticks of hunger, and flying slowly drains it.
badge.mms_origins.fairy_flight.1: Below 3 hearts of health you fly at half speed. Below 3 drumsticks of hunger you lose flight and fall.
badge.mms_origins.fairy_flight.2: Sprint while flying to double your speed. Keep it up for 1.5 s and your wings build smoothly to 4x over the next 2 s.
power.mms_origins.skyris_homeland.name: Enchanted Groves
power.mms_origins.skyris_homeland.descri: In the enchanted groves where old magic runs deep, the same woods where Florans work their reclamations, you strike harder, fortune favors you, and your wings carry you faster.
badge.mms_origins.skyris_homeland.0: In a dark forest, the Skyris Vale or one of its sister groves (Weeping Witch Forest, Enchanted Tangle, Ebony Woods, Forgotten Forest, Jacaranda Jungle): +2 attack damage, +3 Luck and 50% faster flight.
power.mms_origins.spore_shift.name: Spore Shift
power.mms_origins.spore_shift.descriptio: Acrid spores always cling to you, and a drifting cloud can be drawn or stowed at will, each drawing on a reserve that mends itself in rest.
badge.mms_origins.spore_shift.0: Press [Secondary] while standing to stow or draw your Drifting spores. Acrid spores are always with you.
power.mms_origins.combat_spores.name: Acrid Spores
power.mms_origins.combat_spores.descript: Bitter spores cling to every strike you land.
badge.mms_origins.combat_spores.1: A hit also doses the target with caustic spores: 1 damage per second for 3 s, never lethal. The same target cannot be dosed again for 12 s.
badge.mms_origins.combat_spores.2: Each dose costs a third of the reserve and some hunger. The reserve refills in 1.5 s after a 3 s pause.
power.mms_origins.drift_spores.name: Drifting Spores
power.mms_origins.drift_spores.descripti: A haze of spores lifts your feet and quickens your hands.
badge.mms_origins.drift_spores.0: While drawn: Speed II and 40% faster attacks while the reserve lasts.
badge.mms_origins.drift_spores.1: Sprinting drains the reserve 5 per second and each hit costs 10, out of 60. It refills in 2 s after a 2 s pause.
badge.mms_origins.drift_spores.2: Crouch and hold [Primary] to sense living things within 24 blocks through walls. Drains the reserve 5 per second.
power.mms_origins.spore_haze.name: Mind Haze
power.mms_origins.spore_haze.description: A green fog of spores that mends you and bends the wills of the beasts caught in it.
badge.mms_origins.spore_haze.0: Press [Primary] while standing to loose a spore haze of 5 blocks radius that lingers 9 s. Cooldown 60 s.
badge.mms_origins.spore_haze.1: Inside the haze you gain Regeneration I while another mob or player shares it. Every other mob in it gets Weakness and Slowness II; other players get Weakness and Slowness I that wear off twice as fast.
badge.mms_origins.spore_haze.2: Any mob it touches becomes your loyal soldier for 30 s: it follows you, fights what you fight or what hurts you, and spares you and your other soldiers. Bosses (over 50 max health) and Grovekeepers are immune to the mind effect.
badge.mms_origins.spore_haze.3: Afterwards the mob returns to its own ways but never turns on you again, unless you strike it first.
power.mms_origins.fungal_constitution.de: Poison and hunger mean nothing to a fungus, but a fruiting body is fragile.
power.mms_origins.saprophyte_diet.name: Saprophyte
power.mms_origins.saprophyte_diet.descri: Only what has rotted will feed you. Clean food turns to ash on your tongue.
badge.mms_origins.saprophyte_diet.0: You can only eat rotten flesh, spider eyes, poisonous potatoes and raw meat or fish.
badge.mms_origins.saprophyte_diet.1: Rotten flesh grants a short burst of Saturation, and its Hunger cannot touch you.
badge.mms_origins.saprophyte_diet.2: Crouch and hold [Secondary] while looking at stone or deepslate within 5 blocks for 1 s to grow it into shroomlight, every 3 s for a little hunger. Letting go early cancels it. Use a placed shroomlight, or eat one from your hand, for 1 hunger and a lot of saturation, and fairies within 12 blocks may add more, likelier the more fairies are near (sure with 3).
power.mms_origins.nether_born.name: Nether Born
power.mms_origins.nether_born.descriptio: The fires of the Nether raised you. Its heat is home, and the Overworld feels cold and harsh.
badge.mms_origins.nether_born.0: You spawn in the Nether, and return there when you die without a bed.
power.mms_origins.fire_resilience.name: Fire Resilience
power.mms_origins.fire_resilience.descri: Flame and lava are the air you grew up in, and they do little to trouble your hide.
badge.mms_origins.fire_resilience.0: Take 50% less fire and lava damage.
power.mms_origins.nether_heat_immunity.d: The Nether's furnace air is your birthright. Heat can never lay you low, no matter the world you walk.
badge.mms_origins.nether_heat_immunity.0: Immune to heat stroke. Take 70% less heat damage and resist heat buildup. You never overheat past half the scale.
power.mms_origins.nether_chill.name: Nether-Blooded
power.mms_origins.nether_chill.descripti: Raised in the Nether's furnace, you feel the Overworld's cold more keenly.
badge.mms_origins.nether_chill.0: Take 25% more freezing damage, and chill a little faster.
power.mms_origins.nether_forage.name: Nether Forager
power.mms_origins.nether_forage.descript: Your kind learned to live on what the crimson waste provides.
badge.mms_origins.nether_forage.0: You can eat crimson and warped fungi, mushrooms and bone meal (2 hunger each).
power.mms_origins.shroomlight_snack.name: Glowcap Feast
power.mms_origins.shroomlight_snack.desc: A shroomlight is a rare treat, and its inner fire lingers in you after it is eaten.
badge.mms_origins.shroomlight_snack.0: You can eat shroomlights (3 hunger), which leave you glowing for 10 s.
power.mms_origins.sun_shy.name: Sun Shy
power.mms_origins.sun_shy.description: The open sky of the overworld is a strange and tiring place, and standing beneath it wears you down.
badge.mms_origins.sun_shy.0: Hunger drains 50% faster while exposed to the sun.
power.mms_origins.gilded_bearing.name: Gilded
power.mms_origins.gilded_bearing.descrip: Gold is your birthright, and you fight hardest when you wear it.
badge.mms_origins.gilded_bearing.1: 28% chance to land a critical hit, plus 18% for each piece of golden armor worn (certain with a full set).
power.mms_origins.kinsmen.name: Bastion Kin
power.mms_origins.kinsmen.description: Piglins and brutes count you as one of their own, and they will trade and fight for you.
badge.mms_origins.kinsmen.0: Piglins and brutes will not target you. If you strike one, only that piglin holds a grudge, until it hits you back.
badge.mms_origins.kinsmen.1: Piglins within 16 blocks rally against anything that attacks you.
badge.mms_origins.kinsmen.2: Piglins barter from a richer loot table for you, and a gold block buys three different goods.
power.mms_origins.arms_dealing.name: Arms Dealing
power.mms_origins.arms_dealing.descripti: The brutes guard the bastion armories. Offer gold and a brute may hand over war gear, or simply pocket your payment.
badge.mms_origins.arms_dealing.0: Drop a gold ingot or block within 12 blocks of a piglin brute. It admires the gold for 6 s, then may barter bastion gear.
badge.mms_origins.arms_dealing.1: An ingot pays out half the time, a block 55% of the time. Otherwise the brute keeps the gold.
power.mms_origins.zombification.name: Zombification
power.mms_origins.zombification.descript: The Overworld air slowly turns you, and a turned piglin has no kin.
badge.mms_origins.zombification.0: Each second in the Overworld fills a 10-minute meter. The Nether drains it, 1 per 2 s, until you turn.
badge.mms_origins.zombification.1: Turned, you can only eat raw meat, fish, rotten flesh or golden food. Piglins flee from you unless you draw a weapon on them.
badge.mms_origins.zombification.2: Cured by eating golden food (even on a full stomach), or by dying.
badge.mms_origins.zombification.3: Once turned, raw meat, fish and rotten flesh restore 100% more hunger and saturation.
power.mms_origins.quarantine_exile.name: Quarantine Exile
power.mms_origins.quarantine_exile.descr: A turned piglin is no one's kin, and while the sickness holds you, your own people want nothing to do with you.
badge.mms_origins.quarantine_exile.0: While turned you suffer constant Weakness and Hunger, and no piglin or brute within 128 blocks of you will barter.
power.mms_origins.beastly.name: Beastly
power.mms_origins.beastly.description: Villagers see a monster from the Nether, not a customer.
badge.mms_origins.beastly.0: Villagers refuse to trade with you unless you wear a carved pumpkin.
power.mms_origins.language_barrier.name: Otherworlder
power.mms_origins.language_barrier.descr: You are a stranger to the surface. Its folk cannot follow your speech, and its fields were never sown for a body like yours.
badge.mms_origins.language_barrier.0: Villager trades cost 25% more of their base price, at least 1 item more each.
badge.mms_origins.language_barrier.1: Crops and baked goods restore 60% less hunger and saturation.
power.mms_origins.beast_tongue.name: Beast Tongue
power.mms_origins.beast_tongue.descripti: Your growling speech unsettles a villager, who takes you for something half-wild and charges you dearly for it.
badge.mms_origins.beast_tongue.0: Villager trades cost 25% more of their base price, at least 1 item more each.
power.mms_origins.seafood_diet.name: Taste of the Deep
power.mms_origins.seafood_diet.descripti: Anything pulled from the water sits well in your belly.
badge.mms_origins.seafood_diet.0: Raw and cooked fish restore 50% more hunger and saturation.
power.mms_origins.carnivore_diet.name: Carnivore Diet
power.mms_origins.carnivore_diet.descrip: Your gut turns on anything green. Only flesh feeds you, and you would sooner take it raw and dripping than cooked.
badge.mms_origins.carnivore_diet.0: You can only eat meat and fish.
badge.mms_origins.carnivore_diet.1: Raw meat and fish restore 100% more hunger and 150% more saturation.
badge.mms_origins.carnivore_diet.2: Cooked meat, fish and meals restore 25% more hunger and saturation.
power.mms_origins.guardian_kinship.name: Guardian Kinship
power.mms_origins.guardian_kinship.descr: Guardians and elder guardians know you for kin and leave you in peace, unless you strike first.
badge.mms_origins.guardian_kinship.0: Guardians and elder guardians ignore you unless you attack them.
power.mms_origins.guardian_beam.name: Guardian Beam
power.mms_origins.guardian_beam.descript: As the guardians of the deep do, you focus the sea into a searing beam.
badge.mms_origins.guardian_beam.0: Hold [Primary] to lock onto a creature in view within 16 blocks. Keep it in sight for 1.5 s to strike it for 2 hearts, ignoring armor and Protection. Half a second later it arcs once to every hostile creature that was within 3 blocks of it, for 75% of the damage.
badge.mms_origins.guardian_beam.1: Needs half a Tide Magic bar and 23% moisture, and spends both. Full moisture covers four strikes.
power.mms_origins.cold_blooded.name: Fish Anatomy
power.mms_origins.cold_blooded.descripti: Gills, fins and deep-water eyes: a body built for the sea, and as cold as its depths.
badge.mms_origins.cold_blooded.0: Immune to freezing damage, and the cold never takes hold of you.
badge.mms_origins.cold_blooded.3: Tap [Secondary] to dash: a 12 block surge in water, or a 6 block dash on land at 35% moisture or more (both +1 per Depth Strider level). Costs 15% of your Tide Magic and 2.5% moisture, with a 3.5 s cooldown. You cannot jump for 0.5 s after.
badge.mms_origins.cold_blooded.4: In water, hold [Secondary] for half a second to toggle clear underwater vision.
power.mms_origins.tide_magic.name: Tide Magic
power.mms_origins.tide_magic.description: You channel the sea through the water you carry, in dash and beam and tide.
badge.mms_origins.tide_magic.0: Dash needs and spends 15% of your magic bar. Riptide on land needs your magic bar at half or more and spends half of it. Guardian Beam needs and spends half the bar.
badge.mms_origins.tide_magic.1: The bar refills fully in 10 s.
power.mms_origins.like_water.name: Like Water
power.mms_origins.like_water.description: The sea is yours to move through as freely as others walk on land.
badge.mms_origins.like_water.0: No underwater mining penalty, even while floating off the ground.
power.mms_origins.seaborn.name: Seaborn
power.mms_origins.seaborn.description: Born to the sea, you can find no rest on dry land.
badge.mms_origins.seaborn.1: You can only sleep or set your spawn while standing in water.
power.mms_origins.seaborn.cant_sleep: You cannot rest out of the water.
power.mms_origins.water_power.name: Water Power
power.mms_origins.water_power.descriptio: The tide answers your blows, and wet, you strike far harder.
badge.mms_origins.water_power.0: Deal +2 damage while in water or rain, or at 35% moisture or more.
badge.mms_origins.water_power.1: Deal 2 less damage in the Nether and in hot biomes, with no bonus there.
badge.mms_origins.water_power.2: Your trident deals 1.5x damage when you and your target are both in water, thrown or in melee.
badge.mms_origins.water_power.3.prefix: You are able to craft tridents.
power.mms_origins.wetness.name: Wetness
power.mms_origins.wetness.description: The moisture beneath your skin: the sea you carry, which you breathe by and channel your magic through.
badge.mms_origins.wetness.0: Water, rain and cauldrons refill it in about 10 s. A potion or water skin refills 20% over 2 s.
badge.mms_origins.wetness.1: It drains 1 point a second out of water (twice as fast in the Nether), 10 minutes from full. You breathe on land while any remains.
badge.mms_origins.wetness.2: Conduit Power on land refills it to full and holds it there.
badge.mms_origins.wetness.3: If you catch fire, 5% of your moisture puts the flames out at once.
power.mms_origins.grass_matchup.name: Type Advantage
power.mms_origins.grass_matchup.descript: Roots drink deep, and the creatures of the sea wilt before them. Flame wilts the green in turn.
badge.mms_origins.grass_matchup.0: Deal 50% more damage to fishmen and aquatic mobs.
badge.mms_origins.grass_matchup.1: Deal a further 50% more to a fishman who is wet (in water, in rain, or at 35% moisture or more).
badge.mms_origins.grass_matchup.2: Deal 50% less damage to blazeborn, blazes, magma cubes, ghasts and striders.
power.mms_origins.water_matchup.name: Type Advantage
power.mms_origins.water_matchup.descript: Water smothers flame. You fall hard on blazeborn and fiery creatures, but the green drinks you in.
badge.mms_origins.water_matchup.0: Deal 50% more damage to blazeborn, blazes, magma cubes, ghasts and striders.
power.mms_origins.fire_matchup.name: Type Advantage
power.mms_origins.fire_matchup.descripti: Fire withers the green and hisses against the sea, which washes over you all the harder.
badge.mms_origins.fire_matchup.0: Deal 50% more damage to florans, and a further 50% while you are on fire.
badge.mms_origins.fire_matchup.1: Deal 50% less damage to fishmen and aquatic mobs.
badge.mms_origins.fire_matchup.2: Take 50% more damage from guardians, pufferfish and dolphins.
power.mms_origins.sunlit_vigor.name: Sunlit Vigor
power.mms_origins.sunlit_vigor.descripti: Under open sky your sap runs hot, and your blows land harder.
badge.mms_origins.sunlit_vigor.0: 35% chance to land a critical hit while exposed to the sun. Sunlit Fury replaces this while it is active.
power.mms_origins.verdant_growth.name: In Tune With Nature
power.mms_origins.verdant_growth.descrip: Life quickens around you, and the green things you pass lean toward the light.
badge.mms_origins.verdant_growth.0: Plants within about 2 chunks of you grow roughly 30% faster, rising by 10% for each fairy within 12 blocks, up to 60% with 3.
power.mms_origins.sun_power.name: Sun Power
power.mms_origins.sun_power.description: You store sunlight as a quiet inner glow, to be spent when the need is great.
badge.mms_origins.sun_power.0: A reserve of 84 sun, spent on Sunlit Fury, Grovekeepers and Nature's Reclamation.
badge.mms_origins.sun_power.1: Refills only under open sky, faster as the sun nears noon. How much you can hold rises with the sun and ebbs as it sets, down to half the reserve at night; sun above that spills away. Around high noon this peaks as Mael's Blessing, which empowers your other sun powers.
badge.mms_origins.sun_power.2: Drinking a potion or water skin gives 10 sun, filling you up to half the reserve, so you can raise a Grovekeeper even at night.
power.mms_origins.sunlit_fury.name: Sunlit Fury
power.mms_origins.sunlit_fury.descriptio: Burn the light you carry and fight like a thing possessed, until the glow gutters out.
badge.mms_origins.sunlit_fury.0: [Primary] toggles. While active you deal +3 melee damage and burn Sun Power.
badge.mms_origins.sunlit_fury.1: A full reserve lasts about 28 s alone, 14 s with one Grovekeeper and 9 s with two or more. It switches off when Sun Power runs out.
badge.mms_origins.sunlit_fury.2: Under Mael's Blessing: another +3 damage, 25% less damage taken and 20% more speed.
power.mms_origins.summon_henchmen.name: Grovekeepers
power.mms_origins.summon_henchmen.descri: Coax a creaking Grovekeeper out of the earth, a patient guardian that stands between you and harm.
badge.mms_origins.summon_henchmen.0: Hold [Secondary] (not sneaking) for 1.5 s to raise a Grovekeeper. Costs 3 sections of Sun Power; letting go early costs nothing.
badge.mms_origins.summon_henchmen.1: Up to 2 at once, or 4 under Mael's Blessing. Each lasts 2 minutes, then crumbles and refunds its cost.
badge.mms_origins.summon_henchmen.2: They slow what they hit for 5 s, draw nearby hostiles off you, and freeze while their target is looking at them.
badge.mms_origins.summon_henchmen.3: A slain Grovekeeper refunds its cost after 30 s. One more than 32 blocks from you withers away and refunds at once.
badge.mms_origins.summon_henchmen.4: Raised under Mael's Blessing, they have 50% more health and damage, and run up to 30% faster at noon.
power.mms_origins.nature_reclaim.name: Nature's Reclamation
power.mms_origins.nature_reclaim.descrip: Ask the growing world to take back what hands have made. Your body keeps a biological clock that tells you when the sun, and your strength, will peak.
badge.mms_origins.nature_reclaim.0: While the sun is up, hold a crafted item in your off hand and hold [Primary] for 5 s to unmake the whole stack into its ingredients. Sneak with an empty off hand to unmake your main-hand item instead, such as a two-handed weapon. You are rooted in place while you channel.
badge.mms_origins.nature_reclaim.1: Each reclamation costs Sun Power on a tide: at sunrise and sunset it would take twice your full reserve, falling to 35% of it at noon. Away from open sky it never costs less than half your reserve. After each reclamation you must wait 15 s.
badge.mms_origins.nature_reclaim.2: Enchantments move onto books, one per book in your inventory. Any beyond your books are lost.
message.mms_origins.nature_reclaim.no_su: You lack the sun power to reclaim this.
power.mms_origins.leaf_form.name: Leaf Form
power.mms_origins.leaf_form.description: Fold yourself into a drift of leaves, and slip through soil and bough like a breath of wind.
badge.mms_origins.leaf_form.0: Sneak and press [Secondary] to fold into leaf form over half a second, slowed while you change. Repeat to return, which needs you within a block of the surface.
badge.mms_origins.leaf_form.1: In leaf form you pass through and sink into dirt, farmland, leaves, logs, roots, mushroom blocks and moss, and climb them along with sand, gravel and clay. Stone stops you. You cannot jump.
badge.mms_origins.leaf_form.2: In leaf form you cannot sprint, use items, or interact with blocks and creatures, except to plant and to ride your own Grovekeeper. You drift at a steady pace, a little slower than a running player above ground. Buried or in water, you hover, rising with [Jump] and sinking with [Sneak], and you never take fall damage. Buried, you speed up the longer you keep moving, reaching 25 blocks per second after 3 s.
badge.mms_origins.leaf_form.3: Sunlight heals you half a heart every 2.5 s.
badge.mms_origins.leaf_form.5: Buried, your breath drains quickly. With none left you take 2 drowning damage every second.
badge.mms_origins.leaf_form.6: Right-click farmland or soil to plant seeds, saplings, crops and flowers.
badge.mms_origins.leaf_form.7: Inside farmland or a crop with Sunlit Fury active, you gain Saturation every second.
badge.mms_origins.leaf_form.8: Right-click your own Grovekeeper to ride it, and sneak to dismount. It ages twice as fast while ridden, and if it falls you recover half its Sun Power cost at once.
badge.mms_origins.leaf_form.9: Take 15% more damage while riding a Grovekeeper.
message.mms_origins.nature_reclaim.not_e: You need a full crafted item to reclaim.
message.mms_origins.nature_reclaim.succe: The item unravels into its parts, drawing %s sun.
badge.mms_origins.nature_reclaim.3: Your biological clock chimes shortly before noon, when your strength peaks.
badge.mms_origins.nature_reclaim.4: In the enchanted groves the fairies call home (dark forests, the Skyris Vale and their sister groves), sunlight fills you 50% faster.
message.mms_origins.nature_reclaim.not_d: This magic needs the sun in the sky.
message.mms_origins.nature_reclaim.coold: Your sap still stirs. Wait %s s before reclaiming again.
origin.mms_origins.arachnid.name: Arachnid
origin.mms_origins.arachnid.description: Eight-legged hunters of cave and canopy, who spin their silk into roads and snares and climb where others dare not look. Their venom is patient, their bodies are slight, and every cousin of the arthropod kind knows them as kin.
power.mms_origins.master_of_webs.name: Master of Webs
power.mms_origins.master_of_webs.descrip: Silk is a road, a snare and a home to you, and cobwebs bend to your will.
badge.mms_origins.master_of_webs.0: Hold [Primary] to shoot a web and keep hold of it. On a block within 72 blocks you swing from it; hold Use with an empty hand to reel in, faster after 1 s, and let go of [Primary] mid-reel to fling yourself up. On a creature within 24 blocks the web tethers it: it cannot stray past the rope, holding Use with an empty hand slowly hauls it in, and crouching lets it out. Reeled creatures are Webbed, 35% slower for 3 s.
badge.mms_origins.master_of_webs.1: Holds 20 silk. A web on a block costs 2. Webbing a creature costs 1, holding it costs 1 more every 0.75 s, and reeling it costs 1 every 0.25 s instead. One regrows every 2 s, and sleeping refills it.
badge.mms_origins.master_of_webs.2: Cobwebs do not slow you, and you can climb them while climbing is on.
badge.mms_origins.master_of_webs.3.suffi: Sneak to cut a cobweb almost instantly and get back its 9 string. Otherwise webs resist breaking so you do not tear them by accident.
power.mms_origins.venom.name: Venom
power.mms_origins.venom.description: Your bite carries a patient poison that lays low what you cannot outrun.
badge.mms_origins.venom.0: [Secondary] swaps between Climbing and Venom. Venom works only while climbing is off.
badge.mms_origins.venom.1: Venom mode: each melee hit has a 20% chance to inflict Poison II for 5 s that ignores armor and Protection, then a 5 s lull.
power.mms_origins.climbing.name: Climbing
power.mms_origins.climbing.description: Your legs grip any wall as surely as a ladder.
badge.mms_origins.climbing.0: [Secondary] swaps between Climbing and Venom. Climbing is on by default.
badge.mms_origins.climbing.1: No mining speed penalty while clinging to a wall.
badge.mms_origins.climbing.2: While climbing is on, your attack reach grows by 25% and each hit has a 30% chance to slow its target for 2 s, or 60% on a critical hit.
power.mms_origins.arachnid_diet.name: Fresh Kill
power.mms_origins.arachnid_diet.descript: A spider wants its prey fresh. Cooking takes the life out of a meal.
badge.mms_origins.arachnid_diet.0: Raw meat and fish restore 50% more hunger and 100% more saturation.
badge.mms_origins.arachnid_diet.1: Cooked meat, fish and meals restore 25% less hunger and saturation.
power.mms_origins.arachnid_frailty.name: Frail Carapace
power.mms_origins.arachnid_frailty.descr: A lean, many-jointed body trades toughness for nimbleness.
power.mms_origins.arthropod.name: Arthropod
power.mms_origins.arthropod.description: Small, light and quick to land on your feet, you are every inch an insect.
badge.mms_origins.arthropod.0: You stand 15% shorter, about 1.5 blocks tall.
badge.mms_origins.arthropod.1: Falls up to 16 blocks deal no damage.
badge.mms_origins.arthropod.2: Weapons with Bane of Arthropods hit you harder.
power.mms_origins.arthropod_kinship.name: Arthropod Kinship
power.mms_origins.arthropod_kinship.desc: Spiders, bees, silverfish and other arthropods see you as one of their own. They leave you be unless you strike them, and rush to your side when you are hurt.
badge.mms_origins.arthropod_kinship.0: Arthropods will not attack you unless you hurt them first.
badge.mms_origins.arthropod_kinship.1: Arthropods within 10 blocks attack whatever damages you.
power.mms_origins.avian_diet.name: Fruit and Seed
power.mms_origins.avian_diet.description: Light bodies run on fresh fruit and greens, and take little from heavy baking.
badge.mms_origins.avian_diet.0: Fruit, vegetables and berries restore 25% more hunger and 50% more saturation.
badge.mms_origins.avian_diet.1: Bread, cookies and pies restore 25% less hunger and saturation.
power.mms_origins.avian_peace.name: Beloved
power.mms_origins.avian_peace.descriptio: Creatures in every realm love you, and their monsters hold their claws. Only phantoms, the old rivals of the sky, still hunt you.
badge.mms_origins.avian_peace.0: Hostile mobs in every dimension ignore you, except phantoms and bosses (over 50 max health), until you attack one. That turns every hostile mob within 24 blocks of it against you.
origin.mms_origins.avian.name: Avian
origin.mms_origins.avian.description: A gentle, hollow-boned people who never lost the gift of flight. Beloved by the creatures of the overworld and tolerated by its monsters, they hold the sky as their own, though the sky is no place for the brittle.
power.mms_origins.slow_falling.name: Featherweight
power.mms_origins.slow_falling.descripti: You fall as gently to the ground as a feather would.
badge.mms_origins.slow_falling.1: While on: a gentle fall with no fall damage, and 15% more speed. It draws on a feather bar for about 22 s aloft, and refills 3 s after you stop using it.
power.mms_origins.bird_bones.name: Hollow Bones
power.mms_origins.bird_bones.description: Your bones are hollow like a bird's. They keep you light enough to fly, but leave you brittle.
badge.mms_origins.bird_bones.0: You take 18% more damage from all sources.
power.mms_origins.animal_friendship.name: Animal Friendship
power.mms_origins.animal_friendship.desc: Wild things feel no fear around you, and their trust comes without bribes.
badge.mms_origins.animal_friendship.0: Press [Primary] on a tameable animal within 3 blocks to tame it at once. 2-minute cooldown.
badge.mms_origins.animal_friendship.1: Tameable animals: wolves, cats, parrots, horses, donkeys, mules and llamas.
badge.mms_origins.animal_friendship.2: Foxes, ocelots and axolotls within 16 blocks trust you, do not flee, and will even fight for you.
power.mms_origins.green_thumb.name: Green Thumb
power.mms_origins.green_thumb.descriptio: Green things grow plentiful at your touch.
badge.mms_origins.green_thumb.0: Harvesting crops with a hoe drops 1 to 2 extra. Each fairy within 12 blocks gives a third chance of 2 to 3 instead, certain with 3 fairies.
badge.mms_origins.green_thumb.1: Hoe-harvested carrots and melon slices have a 12% chance to drop a golden form (4% more per fairy within 12 blocks, up to 24% with 3), and oak or dark oak leaves broken with a hoe may drop a golden apple.
badge.mms_origins.green_thumb.2: You can eat glistering melon slices.
origin.mms_origins.blazeborn.name: Blazeborn
origin.mms_origins.blazeborn.description: Late descendants of the Blaze, born of flame and fed on fuel. They gather fire like breath and spend it to burn, to fly and to hurl embers, but water and cold are their enemies, and the fire is always hungry.
power.mms_origins.blaze_flight.name: Blaze Flight
power.mms_origins.blaze_flight.descripti: Your fire spreads into wings that carry you above the world, burning as you climb.
badge.mms_origins.blaze_flight.0: Double-tap jump to fly while you have Fire Power and more than 3 drumsticks of hunger.
badge.mms_origins.blaze_flight.1: Flying burns 10 Fire Power per second and sets you alight. You fall when it runs out.
badge.mms_origins.blaze_flight.2: Flying through lava refills the bar instead.
badge.mms_origins.blaze_flight.3: Sprinting while flying doubles your speed. Keep it up for 1.5 s and you build smoothly over 2 s to an avian's top surge speed.
power.mms_origins.molten_core.name: Molten Core
power.mms_origins.molten_core.descriptio: Lava and fire are your forge. You wade through molten rock as though it were open air, and the flames stoke your powers back to readiness.
badge.mms_origins.molten_core.0: Swim through lava at triple speed.
badge.mms_origins.molten_core.1: Fire Power fills twice as fast in lava, and 87.5% faster standing in fire.
power.mms_origins.burning_wrath.name: Burning Wrath
power.mms_origins.burning_wrath.descript: For centuries the Blazeborn have called on fire to aid them in both fight and survival.
badge.mms_origins.burning_wrath.0: [Primary] sets you ablaze for 30 s. Costs 40 Fire Power, and needs more than 3 drumsticks of hunger.
badge.mms_origins.burning_wrath.1: While ablaze: 35% chance to land a critical hit, and hits ignite targets for 6 s, once every 10 s.
badge.mms_origins.burning_wrath.2: While ablaze, use campfires to light them and furnaces, smokers, blast furnaces and brewing stands to fuel them.
power.mms_origins.feed_the_flame.name: Feed the Flame
power.mms_origins.feed_the_flame.descrip: No ordinary meal sustains a creature of fire. You subsist by burning fuel, which stokes you richly.
badge.mms_origins.feed_the_flame.0: While on fire, you can eat coal, charcoal, logs, planks, saplings, sticks, bamboo, mushrooms and fungi, each restoring 8 hunger.
badge.mms_origins.feed_the_flame.1: You cannot eat normal food such as meat or vegetables.
power.mms_origins.drink_lava.name: Drink the Deep
power.mms_origins.drink_lava.description: Lava is the richest draught of all.
badge.mms_origins.drink_lava.0: While on fire, drinking a lava bucket restores 8 hunger and 12.8 saturation.
power.mms_origins.fiery_metabolism.name: Fiery Metabolism
power.mms_origins.fiery_metabolism.descr: The fire within you burns hot and hungry.
power.mms_origins.firecharged_projectile: Ember and spite gather in your palm, ready to be flung.
badge.mms_origins.firecharged_projectile: [Secondary] hurls 3 blaze fireballs in a row, slightly scattered. 10 s cooldown, and needs more than 3 drumsticks of hunger.

Hold [Primary] and [Secondary] together to fling a wildfire shield straight ahead. It flies 20 blocks and explodes on the first creature it touches. 15 s cooldown, and needs more than 3 drumsticks of hunger. [Primary] and [Secondary] alone act when you let go.
power.mms_origins.fire_immunity.name: Fire Immunity
power.mms_origins.fire_immunity.descript: Flame cannot touch what is made of flame.
badge.mms_origins.fire_immunity.0: Immune to fire and lava damage, with lava vision, and immune to heat stroke. Heat never builds up in you.
badge.mms_origins.fire_immunity.1: Take 65% less damage from explosions. Only the blast's shockwave hurts you, never its heat.
power.mms_origins.blaze_kinship.name: Blaze Kinship
power.mms_origins.blaze_kinship.descript: Blazes recognize you as one of their own and will not attack you. Neither of your fireballs can harm the other.
power.mms_origins.gift_of_the_skies.name: Gift of the Skies
power.mms_origins.gift_of_the_skies.desc: Your wings fold against your back like a promise, and open wide on the wind.
badge.mms_origins.gift_of_the_skies.0: Press [Primary] while gliding to surge in the direction you look, once per second. Costs 100 of 1360 stamina, or 150 in armor of 13 to 19. Your hits deal 50% less damage for 1 s after a surge. Hold Jump while gliding to fly where you look at up to 25 blocks per second, pulling hardest when you look almost straight up. Armor weakens the pull. Costs 10 stamina a second (15 in armor of 13 to 19).
badge.mms_origins.gift_of_the_skies.1: Hold [Secondary] for half a second to fold or spread your wings.
badge.mms_origins.gift_of_the_skies.2: Stamina refills in 15 s while you are not gliding. Armor of 20 or more is too heavy to surge.
badge.mms_origins.gift_of_the_skies.3: Fireworks cannot be used while gliding.
badge.mms_origins.gift_of_the_skies.4: Equip an elytra to show vanilla wings in place of your chosen ones, which enables elytra resource packs and cape patterns.
power.mms_origins.companion_mounting.des: A trusted friend may cling to your back and share the sky.
badge.mms_origins.companion_mounting.0: Sneak so another player can mount you. [Secondary] kicks them off, and you wait 5 s before the next mount.
badge.mms_origins.companion_mounting.2: A crash or a hit from any projectile throws your passenger off.
power.mms_origins.aerial_combatant.name: Aerial Combatant
power.mms_origins.aerial_combatant.descr: A strike from the open sky carries the whole weight of the wind behind it.
badge.mms_origins.aerial_combatant.0: 28% chance to land a critical hit while you are off the ground.
origin.mms_origins.enderian.name: Enderian
origin.mms_origins.enderian.description: Born in the long shadow of the Ender Dragon, Enderians step through the world as if it were a doorway. Tall and strange, they are kin to the endermen, but water scalds them and warmth withers them.
power.mms_origins.throw_ender_pearl.name: Teleportation
power.mms_origins.throw_ender_pearl.desc: Whenever you wish, you may toss a pearl and step through space to where it lands.
badge.mms_origins.throw_ender_pearl.0: [Primary] throws a harmless ender pearl and teleports you to it. 1.5 s cooldown, and you cannot suffocate on landing.
power.mms_origins.slender_body.name: Slender Body
power.mms_origins.slender_body.descripti: Your body is long and strange like your kin the endermen, taller, farther reaching, and hard to hit.
badge.mms_origins.slender_body.0: You are 33% larger, about 2.4 blocks tall.
badge.mms_origins.slender_body.1: Reach: 6 blocks to attack and 5 blocks to break or place.
badge.mms_origins.slender_body.2: A projectile that would hit you teleports you away instead, every 2.5 s.
badge.mms_origins.slender_body.3: Bare-handed, you break blocks as if with Silk Touch.
badge.mms_origins.slender_body.4: Your long limbs strike 2 harder and stride 15% faster.
power.mms_origins.hardy_frame.name: Hardy Frame
power.mms_origins.hardy_frame.descriptio: Your kind endure the barren End on almost nothing, and a little food carries you far.
power.mms_origins.ender_kinship.name: Ender Kinship
power.mms_origins.ender_kinship.descript: Endermen see you as one of their own, so meeting their gaze never provokes them.
badge.mms_origins.ender_kinship.0: Endermen do not become hostile when you look at them.
origin.mms_origins.beastfolk.name: Beastfolk
origin.mms_origins.beastfolk.description: Part human, part beast, hardy hunters with a predator's grace and a predator's hunger. Prey flees their scent and skeletons shy from their claws, but stone is a stubborn foe and villagers fear their growl.
power.mms_origins.claw_mode.name: Claws Out
power.mms_origins.claw_mode.description: Draw your claws, and the hunt begins.
badge.mms_origins.claw_mode.0: [Secondary] toggles your claws, which power claw strikes, night vision and longer sprinting leaps.
power.mms_origins.natural_hunter.name: Natural Hunter
power.mms_origins.natural_hunter.descrip: Empty hands become claws that can be honed on wood and stone.
badge.mms_origins.natural_hunter.0: With an empty main hand and claws out, your attacks become sweeping claw strikes that reach 1 block farther.
badge.mms_origins.natural_hunter.1: Hone claws by using blocks in order: logs or wool (4 attack), smooth stone, polished granite, andesite or diorite (5), iron block (6), diamond block (7), netherite block (8). Netherite claws cut through armor for extra damage.
badge.mms_origins.natural_hunter.2: Claw strikes knock back less, for faster follow-ups. Repeated swings slowly dull your claws, netherite claws dull faster against armored foes, and dying blunts them further.
power.mms_origins.predators_vigor.name: Predator's Vigor
power.mms_origins.predators_vigor.descri: A hardy hunter shrugs off the elements and strikes with strength, but must feed more often.
badge.mms_origins.predators_vigor.0: Take 70% less freezing and heat damage. You never grow colder or hotter than half the scale.
badge.mms_origins.predators_vigor.1: 21% chance to land a critical hit.
power.mms_origins.predators_appetite.des: A well-fed predator hits harder. The fuller the belly, the deadlier the strike.
badge.mms_origins.predators_appetite.0: 28% chance to land a critical hit above 8 hunger (4 drumsticks), and 42% while saturated.
power.mms_origins.vicious_appearance.des: Your predatory mien sends prey fleeing, and no untamed land beast will bear you as a rider.
badge.mms_origins.vicious_appearance.0: Animals flee you and throw you off. Tamed, undead, aquatic and predator animals are unafraid.
badge.mms_origins.vicious_appearance.1: Skeletons back away from you, as they do from wolves.
power.mms_origins.dexterity.name: Acrobatics
power.mms_origins.dexterity.description: A predator's balance lets you land on your feet and spring from a crouch.
badge.mms_origins.dexterity.0: Hold [Primary] on the ground to charge a leap, then release or jump to spring where you look. Costs a little hunger, with a 4 s cooldown. Falling more than 2 blocks cancels the charge.
power.mms_origins.hunter_physique.name: Hunter's Physique
power.mms_origins.hunter_physique.descri: +2 hearts, but stone mines 50% slower and block reach is 1 shorter.
badge.mms_origins.hunter_physique.0: You mine natural stone and ore blocks 50% slower.
badge.mms_origins.hunter_physique.1: You cannot break sturdy stone such as deepslate, obsidian and blackstone.
badge.mms_origins.hunter_physique.3: Strength, or a pickaxe with Efficiency, lifts the mining penalties.
power.mms_origins.cat_vision.name: Nocturnal
power.mms_origins.cat_vision.description: The dark holds no secrets from a hunter's eyes.
badge.mms_origins.cat_vision.0: Night vision while your claws are out.
power.mms_origins.aquatic.name: Aquatic
power.mms_origins.aquatic.description: Your natural spawnpoint is in the ocean, and you receive more damage from impaling.
origin.mms_origins.phantom.name: Phantom
origin.mms_origins.phantom.description: Half human and half phantom, they drift between flesh and spirit. Bound by soul energy, they take a phantom's winged form at will, slip through solid stone and fade from sight inside it, but sunlight bars their magic and gold turns them away.
power.mms_origins.phantomize.name: Phantom Form
power.mms_origins.phantomize.description: Shed your flesh and take the form of a phantom that flies on wings.
power.mms_origins.phantom_sunburn.name: Sunburn
power.mms_origins.phantom_sunburn.descri: You catch fire in direct sunlight unless you hold an umbrella.
badge.mms_origins.phantom_sunburn.0: Holding an umbrella in either hand blocks the burn. Helmets do not. You start with an umbrella when you choose this origin.
badge.mms_origins.phantomize.0: Sneak and press or hold [Secondary] to transform into a phantom over half a second, and back again. It lasts until you change back and costs no soul energy.
badge.mms_origins.phantomize.1: In Phantom Form you look like a phantom with a smaller body. Having no arms, you will your tools to act with soul magic: each item use costs 5 soul energy, and below 5 you cannot use items. Each melee hit with something in your main hand costs 3, and below 3 you cannot strike with it at all. Bare-handed hits are free. Hostile mobs cannot target you. A mob you strike hunts you down regardless.
badge.mms_origins.phantomize.2: Phantom Form lets you fly by double-tapping jump, free of cost. You glide toward where you look, keep your momentum and bank into turns like a phantom. Braking sheds speed gradually, and slamming into something at speed hurts.
badge.mms_origins.phantomize.3: Sprinting while flying doubles your flight speed. Keep it up for 1.5 s and you build smoothly over 2 s to an avian's top surge speed.
power.mms_origins.phantom_kinship.name: Phantom Kinship
power.mms_origins.phantom_kinship.descri: The phantoms that gather when you go without sleep know you as kin, and that kinship lends you strength.
badge.mms_origins.phantom_kinship.0: Phantoms deal no damage to you.
badge.mms_origins.phantom_kinship.3: Stored souls feed your strikes: 1.2x damage at 25 soul energy, 1.45x at 50 and 1.7x at 80 or more.
badge.mms_origins.phantom_kinship.4: Hostile mobs are neutral to you until you strike one.
power.mms_origins.phasing.name: Phasing
power.mms_origins.phasing.description: In phasing mode you slip through solid stone, though the densest blocks turn you away.
badge.mms_origins.phasing.0: Hold [Primary] (not sneaking) to enter or leave phasing mode, in either form. It costs 1 soul energy every 2 s, and 1 more per second while inside blocks.
badge.mms_origins.phasing.1: While inside blocks you cannot sprint unless flying in Phantom Form, attack, use items or interact with blocks.
badge.mms_origins.phasing.2: Sneak on the ground to sink down. Flying in Phantom Form, you pass through blocks in every direction at full speed. Obsidian-tough blocks, gold blocks and bells cannot be phased through.
badge.mms_origins.phasing.3: In phasing mode you are translucent while you have any soul energy, and invisible while you have more than a third of your soul energy.
badge.mms_origins.phasing.4: Sunlight bars summoning and ends phasing mode. Holding an umbrella in either hand lets you phase in sunlight.
badge.mms_origins.phasing.5: Phasing mode ends when your soul energy runs out.
power.mms_origins.summon_phantoms.name: Summon Phantoms
power.mms_origins.summon_phantoms.descri: Call kindred phantoms out of the dark to fight at your side.
badge.mms_origins.summon_phantoms.0: Sneak and hold [Primary] to summon two phantoms. Costs 40 soul energy, with a 10 s cooldown. Not usable in sunlight.
power.mms_origins.soulbound.name: Soulbound
power.mms_origins.soulbound.description: A phantom's form is held together by souls, and you fade when they run out.
badge.mms_origins.soulbound.0: Soul energy runs from 0 to 100. Outside phasing mode it refills 1 every 0.5 s, and fully on waking or respawning.
badge.mms_origins.soulbound.1: Kills give 5 energy (weak mobs), 25 (medium) or 50 (strong), and a boss (over 50 max health) fills the bar. A Soul Fire Aspect kill gives 15 more. Within 8 blocks of soul fire you gain 4 per second.
badge.mms_origins.soulbound.2: Like a vampire you feed on the living: each hit on a passive creature or villager siphons 2 energy, and killing one draws 10 more on top of the usual amount. Hits on players siphon only 1.
power.mms_origins.spectral_wail.name: Spectral Wail
power.mms_origins.spectral_wail.descript: Screech like a phantom, and the world answers by showing you every living thing nearby.
badge.mms_origins.spectral_wail.0: Hold [Secondary] (not sneaking) to wail. Every non-sneaking creature within 32 blocks glows for 10 s. 30 s cooldown.
power.mms_origins.aurophobia.name: Aurophobia
power.mms_origins.aurophobia.description: Gold has a repellent effect on your kind.
badge.mms_origins.aurophobia.0: You cannot eat golden food, wear golden armor, use golden tools or phase through gold blocks. Held golden tools deal no damage.
badge.mms_origins.aurophobia.1: Foes striking you with a golden tool deal 50% more damage.
origin.mms_origins.shulk.name: Shulk
origin.mms_origins.shulk.description: Kin to the shulkers, with a shell grown like armor over a soft body. They blink away from blows and send homing bullets to lift their foes into the air, though their strength is heavy and their stamina poor.
power.mms_origins.natural_armor.name: Sturdy Skin
power.mms_origins.natural_armor.descript: Even without armor, your shell hardens to turn aside harm.
badge.mms_origins.natural_armor.0: Hold sneak to grow your shell: +1 armor every 2 s, up to +7.
badge.mms_origins.natural_armor.1: A hit of 3 hearts or more cracks it: -2 armor, and no buildup for 30 s.
power.mms_origins.shell_dodge.name: Shell Dodge
power.mms_origins.shell_dodge.descriptio: When a blow lands, you sometimes vanish in a blink and shrug it off, then need a moment to gather yourself.
badge.mms_origins.shell_dodge.0: A hit from a living attacker has a 30% chance to teleport you a few blocks away and negate the damage. 10 s cooldown.
power.mms_origins.shulker_bullets.name: Shulker Bullets
power.mms_origins.shulker_bullets.descri: Your shell stores homing shulker bullets that lift whatever they strike into the air.
badge.mms_origins.shulker_bullets.0: Press [Secondary] to fire a homing bullet at a creature in view within 24 blocks. It levitates for 10 s.
badge.mms_origins.shulker_bullets.1: A levitating victim cannot open an elytra.
badge.mms_origins.shulker_bullets.2: Your shell holds 15 charge and each bullet costs 2, enough for 7 rapid shots. Charge regrows 1 every 2 s.
power.mms_origins.shulker_kinship.name: Shulker Kinship
power.mms_origins.shulker_kinship.descri: Shulkers recognize you as one of their own and will not fire at you.
power.mms_origins.cold_resistance.name: Tempered Skin
power.mms_origins.cold_resistance.descri: Cold bites at you less than most.
badge.mms_origins.cold_resistance.0: Take 70% less freezing damage and resist chill. Water still chills you fast, but never past half the scale.
power.mms_origins.heat_sensitivity.name: Sun-Withered
badge.mms_origins.heat_sensitivity.0: Take double heat damage and heat up faster.
power.mms_origins.enderian_heat_sensitiv: Warmth withers you, save in the Warped Forest, where your kin gather and the heat leaves you be.
badge.mms_origins.enderian_heat_sensitiv: Take double heat damage and heat up faster, except in the Warped Forest.
badge.mms_origins.water_vulnerability.0: Water, rain and water cauldrons deal 2 damage every second (1 on Easy). Water Protection reduces it, and an umbrella blocks rain.
power.mms_origins.blazeborn_water_vulner: Water is agony to your flame, and even the rain scalds you.
badge.mms_origins.blazeborn_water_vulner: Contact with water hurts you twice a second. Rain hurts too, unless you hold an umbrella. Water Protection reduces both.
origin.mms_origins.vanilla_elytra.name: Default
origin.mms_origins.vanilla_elytra.descri: Your wings render as a plain elytra.
origin.mms_origins.feathered_wings.name: Feathered Wings
origin.mms_origins.feathered_wings.descr: Your wings render as soft feathered wings, a custom texture separate from the vanilla Elytra.
origin.mms_origins.golden_wings.name: Golden Wings
origin.mms_origins.golden_wings.descript: Your wings render as gilded feathered wings, a custom texture separate from the vanilla Elytra.
origin.mms_origins.colored_wings.name: Rainbow Wings
origin.mms_origins.colored_wings.descrip: Your wings render as vivid rainbow feathered wings, a custom texture separate from the vanilla Elytra.
origin.mms_origins.paper_wings.name: Paper Wings
origin.mms_origins.paper_wings.descripti: Your wings render as light paper wings, a custom texture separate from the vanilla Elytra.
origin.mms_origins.magic_wings.name: Magic Wings
origin.mms_origins.magic_wings.descripti: Your wings render as shimmering magic wings, a custom texture separate from the vanilla Elytra.
origin.mms_origins.flandre_wings.name: Flandre's Wings
origin.mms_origins.flandre_wings.descrip: Your wings render as Flandre Scarlet's crystalline magic wings, a custom texture separate from the vanilla Elytra.
origin.mms_origins.ikaros_wings.name: Ikaros's Wings
origin.mms_origins.ikaros_wings.descript: Your wings render as Ikaros's rosy synapse wings, a custom texture separate from the vanilla Elytra.
origin.mms_origins.nymph_wings.name: Nymph's Wings
origin.mms_origins.nymph_wings.descripti: Your wings render as Nymph's pale azure synapse wings, a custom texture separate from the vanilla Elytra.
origin.mms_origins.astraea_wings.name: Astraea's Wings
origin.mms_origins.astraea_wings.descrip: Your wings render as Astraea's icy crystal synapse wings, a custom texture separate from the vanilla Elytra.
origin.mms_origins.chaos_wings.name: Chaos's Wings
origin.mms_origins.chaos_wings.descripti: Your wings render as Chaos's violet crystal synapse wings, a custom texture separate from the vanilla Elytra.
origin.mms_origins.hiyori_wings.name: Hiyori's Wings
origin.mms_origins.hiyori_wings.descript: Your wings render as Hiyori's gilded rose synapse wings, a custom texture separate from the vanilla Elytra.
origin.mms_origins.melan_wings.name: Melan's Wings
origin.mms_origins.melan_wings.descripti: Your wings render as Melan's dark crimson synapse wings, a custom texture separate from the vanilla Elytra.
origin.mms_origins.no_render.name: No Wings
origin.mms_origins.no_render.description: Disables the rendering of wings, useful for wingless flight or custom Elytra models via mods like Figura.
layer.mms_origins.avian_wings.name: Wings
mms_origins.gui.choose_avian_wings.title: Choose your Wings.
mms_origins.gui.view_avian_wings.title: These are your chosen Wings.
origin.mms_origins.beastfolk_collar.name: Collar
origin.mms_origins.beastfolk_collar.desc: You live among the other races and wear a belled collar as a sign of good faith. Knowing how a growl frightens them, you have learned to hold yours back, even in pain.
origin.mms_origins.beastfolk_no_collar.d: You keep to the wilds and wear no collar. Rugged and feral, you never learned to swallow a growl, and you care little that it frightens the other races.
layer.mms_origins.beastfolk_options.name: Collar
mms_origins.gui.choose_collar.title: Choose your Collar.
mms_origins.gui.view_collar.title: This is your chosen Collar.
origin.mms_origins.beastfolk_tail_fox.de: A bushy russet tail, dark at the tip and brightening toward the base.
origin.mms_origins.beastfolk_tail_wolf.d: A thick grey tail, dark at the tip and brightening toward the base.
mms_origins.gui.choose_tail.title: Choose your Tail.
mms_origins.gui.view_tail.title: This is your chosen Tail.
advancement.mms_origins.arachnid.bane_of: Take damage from a weapon enchanted with Bane of Arthropods V.
advancement.mms_origins.arachnid.craft_c: Craft a Cobweb out of 9 String.
advancement.mms_origins.arachnid.poison_: Poison all types of Illager and allies using your Venom ability at least once.
advancement.mms_origins.arachnid.webshot: Use your webshot 7 times without touching the ground or climbing.
advancement.mms_origins.avian.root.title: Avian
advancement.mms_origins.avian.buildlimit: Sleep at a height of at least 300 blocks.
advancement.mms_origins.avian.harvest_go: Harvest or craft a golden carrot, glistering melon or golden apple.
advancement.mms_origins.avian.speed.desc: Gain a speed of at least 200%% compared to a human.
advancement.mms_origins.avian.tame.title: Dr. Dolittle
advancement.mms_origins.avian.tame.descr: Tame an animal without using items.
advancement.mms_origins.blazeborn.fuel.t: Fire is Fuel. Nether is Full.
advancement.mms_origins.blazeborn.fuel.d: Use Burning Wrath to fuel a Campfire, Brewing Stand, and Furnace.
advancement.mms_origins.blazeborn.kill_w: Defeat the Wither in the Nether as a Blazeborn.
advancement.mms_origins.blazeborn.reach_: Reach the Overworld as a Blazeborn.
advancement.mms_origins.avian.crash.desc: Take 7 or more hearts of kinetic damage at once.
advancement.mms_origins.avian.flight_att: Use a melee attack while flying at ludicrous speeds.
advancement.mms_origins.avian.player_mou: Let another player mount you and take flight.
advancement.mms_origins.avian.y_700.desc: Reach Y-Coordinate 700 using your flight abilities.
advancement.mms_origins.enderian.max_wat: Equip a piece of armor with Water Protection IV.
advancement.mms_origins.enderian.punch_p: Punch a player or mob that is wearing a Carved Pumpkin.
advancement.mms_origins.beastfolk.break_: Break a tough block using Strength or Efficiency.
advancement.mms_origins.beastfolk.cooked: Carry a full stack of cooked cod or cooked salmon in your inventory.
advancement.mms_origins.beastfolk.sharp_: Use a log, smooth stone, iron block, diamond block and netherite block to fully sharpen your claws.
advancement.mms_origins.beastfolk.sleep_: Sleep in a village with an iron golem nearby.
advancement.mms_origins.fishman.clear_mo: Clear an ocean monument of Elder Guardians.
advancement.mms_origins.fishman.conduit_: Place a Conduit into a valid prismarine frame and receive its effect.
advancement.mms_origins.fishman.loyalty_: Enchant a Trident with Channeling and Loyalty III.
advancement.mms_origins.fishman.nether.d: As a Fishman, enter the Nether.
advancement.mms_origins.phantom.absorb_b: Absorb a boss mob's soul energy.
advancement.mms_origins.phantom.absorb_s: Absorb some Soul Energy from Soul Fire.
advancement.mms_origins.phantom.phase_at: Hit a player or mob while phased halfway into the ground.
advancement.mms_origins.phantom.spectral: Detect a mob or player through walls by using your Spectral Wail.
advancement.mms_origins.shulk.root.title: Shulk
Put an item into your Shulker Inventory.
Equip Armor and charge Sturdy Skin until you reach 30 Armor Points.
advancement.mms_origins.shulk.shulker_bu: As Shulk, get hit by a Shulker Bullet.
advancement.mms_origins.shulk.tank_warde: Endure a melee hit from the Warden without wearing any physical armor.
power.mms_origins.carnivore.name: Carnivore
power.mms_origins.carnivore.description: Your diet is restricted to meat, you can't eat vegetables.
power.mms_origins.fresh_air.name: Fresh Air
power.mms_origins.fresh_air.description: When sleeping, your bed needs to be at an altitude of at least 86 blocks, so you can breathe fresh air.
power.mms_origins.hotblooded.name: Hotblooded
power.mms_origins.hotblooded.description: Due to your hot body, venoms burn up, making you immune to poison and hunger status effects.
power.mms_origins.lay_eggs.name: Oviparous
power.mms_origins.lay_eggs.description: Whenever you wake up in the morning, you will lay an egg.
power.mms_origins.like_air.name: Like Air
power.mms_origins.like_air.description: Modifiers to your walking speed also apply while you're airborne.
power.mms_origins.more_exhaustion.name: Large Appetite
power.mms_origins.more_exhaustion.descri: You exhaust much quicker than others, thus requiring you to eat more.
power.mms_origins.more_kinetic_damage.de: You take more damage from falling and flying into blocks.
power.mms_origins.nether_spawn.name: Nether Inhabitant
power.mms_origins.nether_spawn.descripti: Your natural spawn will be in the Nether.
power.mms_origins.no_shield.name: Unwieldy
power.mms_origins.no_shield.description: The way your hands are formed provide no way of holding a shield upright.
power.mms_origins.pumpkin_hate.name: Scared of Gourds
power.mms_origins.pumpkin_hate.descripti: You are afraid of pumpkins. For a good reason.
power.mms_origins.shulker_inventory.name: Hoarder
power.mms_origins.shulker_inventory.desc: You have access to an additional 9 slots of inventory, which keep the items on death.
power.mms_origins.strong_arms.name: Strong Arms
power.mms_origins.strong_arms.descriptio: You are strong enough to break natural stones without using a pickaxe.
power.mms_origins.tailwind.name: Tailwind
power.mms_origins.tailwind.description: You are a little bit quicker on foot than others.
power.mms_origins.vegetarian.name: Vegetarian
power.mms_origins.velvet_paws.name: Velvet Paws
power.mms_origins.velvet_paws.descriptio: Your footsteps don't cause any vibrations which could otherwise be picked up by nearby lifeforms.
power.mms_origins.water_breathing.name: Gills
power.mms_origins.water_breathing.descri: You can breathe underwater, but not on land.
While wet, submerged or under open rain, you carry the strength of a conduit with you.
power.mms_origins.burn_in_daylight.name: Photoallergic
power.mms_origins.burn_in_daylight.descr: You begin to burn in daylight if you are not invisible.
origin.mms_origins.human.name: Human
origin.mms_origins.human.description: A regular human. Your ordinary Minecraft experience awaits.
origin.mms_origins.fishman.name: Fishman
origin.mms_origins.fishman.description: Children of the deep who carry a little of the sea inside them. Wet, they are tireless and fierce, and the tide bends to their will; dry, they parch, and the surface world has no kindness for them.
layer.mms_origins.class.name: Class
layer.mms_origins.class.missing_origin.d: You do not have a class.
origin.mms_origins.warrior.name: Warrior
origin.mms_origins.warrior.description:
These honorable fighters favor the sword and shield to take down their foes.

§6Pairs with the Warrior job.§7 Level it for stacking combat bonuses. Powerups you buy in that job also count one rank higher.
origin.mms_origins.archer.name: Archer
origin.mms_origins.archer.description:
One shot, one kill.

§6Pairs with the Archer job.§7 Level it for stacking ranged bonuses. Powerups you buy in that job also count one rank higher.
origin.mms_origins.rogue.name: Rogue
origin.mms_origins.rogue.description:
Usually known to be thieves and robbers, rogues are proficient in ambushes and stealth attacks.

§6Pairs with the Rogue job.§7 Level it for stacking stealth bonuses. Powerups you buy in that job also count one rank higher.
origin.mms_origins.beastmaster.name: Beastmaster
origin.mms_origins.beastmaster.descripti:
Beastmasters are solitary people who prefer the company of animals.

§6Pairs with the Beastmaster job.§7 Level it for stacking taming bonuses. Powerups you buy in that job also count one rank higher.
origin.mms_origins.blacksmith.name: Blacksmith
origin.mms_origins.blacksmith.descriptio:
Valued friends of anyone, Blacksmiths are able to create better tools, weapons and armor.

§6Pairs with the Blacksmith job.§7 Level it for stacking forging bonuses. Powerups you buy in that job also count one rank higher.
origin.mms_origins.cleric.name: Cleric
origin.mms_origins.cleric.description:
They have learned how to channel the magic present in the world and use that to their advantage.

§6Pairs with the Cleric job.§7 Level it for stacking brewing bonuses. Powerups you buy in that job also count one rank higher.
origin.mms_origins.cook.name: Cook
origin.mms_origins.cook.description:
There is no one better to prepare your food than a Cook.

§6Pairs with the Cook job.§7 Level it for stacking cooking bonuses. Powerups you buy in that job also count one rank higher.
origin.mms_origins.farmer.name: Farmer
origin.mms_origins.farmer.description:
Farmers have been known to provide everyone with food for as long as anyone can remember.

§6Pairs with the Farmer job.§7 Level it for stacking harvest bonuses. Powerups you buy in that job also count one rank higher.
origin.mms_origins.merchant.name: Merchant
origin.mms_origins.merchant.description:
Always looking for an additional emerald, Merchants are proficient traders.

§6Pairs with the Merchant job.§7 Level it for stacking trading bonuses. Powerups you buy in that job also count one rank higher.
origin.mms_origins.rancher.name: Rancher
origin.mms_origins.rancher.description:
Making the most of animals, Ranchers are able to gather many useful resources.

§6Pairs with the Rancher job.§7 Level it for stacking livestock bonuses. Powerups you buy in that job also count one rank higher.
origin.mms_origins.miner.name: Miner
origin.mms_origins.miner.description:
Miners are the most proficient at digging up the earth's treasures.

§6Pairs with the Miner job.§7 Holding both makes the job's vein mining faster and easier on your pickaxe, doubles bonus ore drops and improves pickaxe enchanting. Powerups you buy in that job also count one rank higher.
origin.mms_origins.lumberjack.name: Lumberjack
origin.mms_origins.lumberjack.descriptio:
Trees should watch out when Lumberjacks are around.

§6Pairs with the Lumberjack job.§7 Holding both doubles bonus wood drops and improves axe enchanting. Powerups you buy in that job also count one rank higher.
origin.mms_origins.explorer.name: Explorer
origin.mms_origins.explorer.description:
Explorers find their way through the most difficult terrain easily and discover hidden landmarks.

§6Pairs with the Explorer job.§7 Holding both adds Fortune, Looting and Luck, and cheaper villager trades. Powerups you buy in that job also count one rank higher.
origin.mms_origins.nitwit.name: Nitwit
origin.mms_origins.nitwit.description: Nitwits aren't really good at anything.
power.mms_origins.less_shield_slowdown.d: You are slowed down less when protecting yourself with a shield.
power.mms_origins.sneaky.name: Sneaky
power.mms_origins.sneaky.description: Your nameplate is never visible through walls, even when you're not sneaking.
power.mms_origins.stealth.name: In the Shadows
power.mms_origins.stealth.description: When you have been sneaking for 10 seconds, you enter Stealth.
power.mms_origins.stealth_descriptor.des: While in stealth, you make less sound and deal extra damage when attacking an enemy from behind. You exit Stealth when you stop sneaking or attack an enemy.
power.mms_origins.less_bow_slowdown.name: Agility
power.mms_origins.less_bow_slowdown.desc: You can move quicker than others while drawing your bow.
power.mms_origins.no_projectile_divergen: All of your projectiles have increased accuracy.
power.mms_origins.more_attack_damage.des: Able to use each weapon to its fullest potential, you deal a bit more damage.
power.mms_origins.tamed_animal_boost.des: Animals you tame receive a permanent buff to their health and strength.
Your nearby tamed animals also receive potion effects when you drink a potion.
power.mms_origins.more_smoker_xp.name: Smoking
power.mms_origins.more_smoker_xp.descrip: You receive more experience from cooking food in a smoker.
power.mms_origins.better_crafted_food.de: Food crafted by you is more saturating.
power.mms_origins.longer_potions.name: Extended Potions
power.mms_origins.longer_potions.descrip: As a last step in potion brewing, you can double a potion's duration with water from a cauldron.
power.mms_origins.better_enchanting.name: Enchantment Mastery
power.mms_origins.better_enchanting.desc: You are able to produce better enchantments at an enchantment table.
power.mms_origins.quality_equipment.name: High-Quality Equipment
power.mms_origins.quality_equipment.desc: Equipment you create provides small buffs.
power.mms_origins.efficient_repairs.name: Efficient Repairs
power.mms_origins.efficient_repairs.desc: Repairing equipment in an anvil costs less material. Repairing by combining equipment restores more durability.
power.mms_origins.more_crop_drops.name: Bountiful Harvest
power.mms_origins.more_crop_drops.descri: When harvesting crops, there is a chance that you receive twice the yield.
power.mms_origins.better_bone_meal.name: Fertilizing Techniques
power.mms_origins.better_bone_meal.descr: Bone meal is twice as effective in your experienced hands when used on crops and plants.
power.mms_origins.twin_breeding.name: Twin Births
power.mms_origins.twin_breeding.descript: Animals bred by you have a chance to produce two babies.
power.mms_origins.more_animal_loot.name: Scavenging
power.mms_origins.more_animal_loot.descr: You are able to sometimes receive more material from killing animals.
power.mms_origins.trade_availability.des: Villagers you trade with never run out of resources to trade for you.
power.mms_origins.rare_wandering_loot.de: You are able to convince wandering traders to offer some of their rarer items to you.
power.mms_origins.no_sprint_exhaustion.d: Sprinting doesn't cause you to exhaust.
power.mms_origins.explorer_kit.name: Explorer Kit
power.mms_origins.explorer_kit.descripti: You start the game with a compass, a clock and nine empty maps.
power.mms_origins.no_mining_exhaustion.d: Breaking blocks doesn't cause you to exhaust.
power.mms_origins.more_break_speed.name: Mining Expert
power.mms_origins.more_break_speed.descr: You mine material quicker than others with your pickaxe.
power.mms_origins.tree_felling.name: Timber!
power.mms_origins.tree_felling.descripti: You cut down whole trees at once, unless you sneak.
You gain two more wooden planks from a single log when crafting.
